RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 25

An all-women panel is not evidence of bias; research shows female evaluators do not systematically favor female candidates. Academic hiring decisions hinge on qualitative criteria beyond raw publication metrics, including interview performance, teaching demonstrations, and specific departmental needs—such as practical curriculum requirements that the candidate’s industry background may satisfy. 

Raising allegations of sex discrimination based solely on panel demographics or CV comparisons is legally unsubstantiated and carries severe professional risks within academic networks. Instead, send a polite follow-up inquiring about constructive feedback to strengthen future applications. Unless official feedback or administrative records reveal clear procedural irregularities, do not attribute the outcome to gender.
